model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, circle markers, solid line), FT (blue, triangle markers, solid line), IKE (red, triangle markers, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond markers, solid line), MEMIT (purple, triangle markers, solid line), and ROME (green, square markers, solid line). The Base line starts at around 38 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 45 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. The FT line begins at around 40 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to about 48 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. The IKE line starts at around 44 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 50 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. The MEND line begins at around 45 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3, increases to about 51 at a Co-occurrence Number of 30, and then rises to approximately 57 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. The MEMIT line starts at around 40 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3, increases to about 51 at a Co-occurrence Number of 30, and then rises to approximately 55 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. The ROME line begins at around 50 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3, increases to about 58 at a Co-occurrence Number of 30, and then rises to approximately 66 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2000. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
